cumleler: What changes when noise rises by just three decibels?
For an eight-hour workday, eighty five decibels A is a key reference.
Under the equal energy principle, every three decibels halves the time.
At eighty eight decibels A, the time falls to about four hours.
At ninety one decibels A, to about two hours.
